blocks.title: TrackMania Highlands
blocks.tagline: The first community environment for TrackMania United Forever.

items.title: New environment
items.text: Adds Highlands as a new environment to TrackMania United Forever.

items.title: Install from the ZIP
items.text: TM Horizon checks TmHighlands.zip from ModDB, backs up the two game files it replaces and unpacks it. Undo puts them back.

items.title: On and off
items.text: Switch Highlands off without uninstalling: the environment and the car are set aside until you switch it on again.

blocks.title: Install
blocks.markdown: Download **TmHighlands.zip** (about 650 MB, 1.55 GB unpacked) from the ModDB page and open the game page of United Forever: the card *Recommended for your game* finds the file in Downloads. Only the GameData folder is unpacked; the readme and credits from the ZIP are shown before you install. Highlands replaces *Game.FidCache.Gbx* and the *BaseEditorSimple* campaign; TM Horizon keeps both, and Undo in History restores them.

blocks.title: Credits
blocks.markdown: TrackMania Highlands is made by the TrackMania Modding Community, 2021–2025, some rights reserved. Project lead: **St1ngLeR** (environment, vehicle, skins, physics), with more modellers named in *Highlands Credits.txt* inside the ZIP. The community Discord is linked in the readme.
